newsitem.title: USA: Sun, LSI work on telecom chip.
newsitem.headline: Sun, LSI work on telecom chip.

text.p: Sun Microsystems Inc and LSI Logic Corp said Wednesday they are working together to develop a computer chip for telecommunications equipment, office machines and network computers.

The new chip, the microSPARC-IIep, was designed by Sun and will be built by LSI. It will be available in samples to customers in a few weeks and available widely by the third quarter, the companies said.
The chip is designed to be a general processor to handle relatively easy computing tasks in various types of electronics.
Sun said the chip also can be used in next-generation network computers based on its Java software technology.
